The examination of the samples synthesized at temperatures Tsyn > 270 °C by atomic force microscopy indicates that the defect-free continuous coating is formed on the glass surface (Fig. 7e). Although the coating is polycrystalline [the boundaries of individual crystallites 100–200 nm in size are distinguishable under examination in the lateral force scanning mode (Fig. 7f)], the differences between the morphologies of central and peripheral regions of crystalline particles are absent.
